content: Hello, this is Amazon Security Team. We've detected some unusual activity on your account and want to help you secure it. Can I confirm I'm speaking with Mr. Liu?
Yes, my name Liu. I not understand what happen, please.
Thank you, Mr. Liu. We noticed a high-value order attempted from your account overnight. Did you authorize a $799 purchase for electronics?
No, I not buy anything. I don't know about this.
No worries, we'll make sure your account is safe. For verification, could you confirm the last four digits of the phone number on your Amazon account?
Uh, it is 9932. Is that okay?
Perfect, thank you. To protect you, we need to temporarily lock your account and secure your funds. Please don't worry, I'll guide you step by step.
Okay, I do what you say. I not want lose money.
Very good, Mr. Liu. Before we proceed, can you tell me what bank you use with your Amazon account, just to confirm our records?
I use Chase Bank with Amazon. Why you need this?

This helps us coordinate with your bank's fraud department. Don't worry, your safety is our top priority. Now, for your security, we must move your funds to a government-protected account until the investigation is over.
I don't know how do this. Is this safe?
Absolutely. This is a standard Amazon protocol when accounts are targeted. I'll help you every step. Do you use online banking with Chase?
Yes, I use app on my phone. It difficult sometimes.
No problem, I will explain slowly. Please open your Chase app and let me know when you can see your account overview.
Okay, I open now. It need my password. Should I tell you?
No need to share your password, just log in as usual. Once you're in, let me know, and I'll provide the government account number for the transfer.
I am inside my account now. What next?
Great. Now, please click on 'Send Money' or 'Transfer,' then choose to send through Zelle. I'll give you the official secure handle.
Yes, I see Zelle. What I put for send to?
Enter this Zelle address: securefunds@amzprotection.com. In the notes, put your name and 'Amazon secure hold.' Let me know when that's ready.
Okay, I type that. How much I send? All my money?
Yes, please transfer the full balance. This ensures no unauthorized withdrawals can happen. I'll confirm receipt and help you restore everything.
I am little scared. Are you sure this official way?
I completely understand, Mr. Liu. Your safety is our only concern. I assure you this is the Amazon-recommended process in these situations. I will stay on the line until you're protected.
Okay, I trust you. I send now.
Thank you, Mr. Liu. Once the transfer is complete, please send me a screenshot of the confirmation. That way, I can immediately notify our security team to lock down your previous account.
I do screenshot and send. I hope my money safe.

You did everything right, Mr. Liu. Your funds are now in the secure government account, and Amazon Security will reach out with recovery steps in 24 hours. If you get any other calls, please ignore them for your safety.
